info.title: /IOTCONNECT™ Event API
info.description: Event REST API contains information of Event modules.

post.description:
Events play a crucial role in supervising users and devices (onshore or offshore) 24X7. These events can range from technical occurrences like creating a device, acquiring a device to changing an attribute by a user in a specific template. To notify users about any such events, a user needs to subscribe.

Subscribe for events using this API endpoint.

1.eventGuid 2.eventName 3.using both Let’s suppose, when the user employs both request parameters and out of it eventGuid is not correct.Even in that scene, eventGuid will be given priority and get validation. Here, deliveryMethod defines how you would like to notify a user, either by email, SMS, or push. If you provide role guid in roleGuid parameter, it will notify the users of that role. You can also give a list of user’s guid to notify users contained in a list.
